summary: A local athlete’s move into Division I competition makes the town paper.
realLife: Local signing-day coverage in Uxbridge, Massachusetts, followed four field hockey players making their college commitments just hours before a high school playoff game. Kendall Gilmore signed to play for Maryland.
inGame: needs: a recorded athletic achievement with its competition level available to the local news desk.

turns.what: The paper holds the story until the college confirms the athlete is on the roster.
turns.pulledBy: The family has announced plans and the roster has yet to be published.
turns.writesBack: The published story uses the confirmed entry date.

turns.what: The athlete makes the college roster and spends the opener on the bench.
turns.pulledBy: The official roster includes the athlete and the game report records no playing time.
turns.writesBack: The hometown story reports the roster spot and saves the debut for the first appearance.
